title: Concept: poetry.lock entry resolved from git
description: poetry.lock declares a locked package whose source type is `git`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code sits outside index publication controls, so the lockfile hash model and advisory ranges do not describe it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: The code sits outside index publication controls, so the lockfile hash model and advisory ranges do not describe it.
